## Report

Built the editor **command + keybinding registry** under `runtime/commands/` (system C of the editor foundation). All files are new and self-contained — no cross-cart imports, no other files touched.

**Files created:**
- `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/runtime/commands/keychord.ts` — chord parser/normalizer repurposed from the `controls.ts` donor. `normalizeChord` canonicalizes any spelling to `ctrl+alt+shift+meta`-ordered form (`'Ctrl+Shift+Z'` ≡ `'shift+z+control'` → `'ctrl+shift+z'`); plus `tryNormalizeChord`, `chordFromEvent` (live keydown), `prettyChord`. Validates base key is alphanumeric so junk never registers.
- `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/runtime/commands/command.ts` — the `CommandDef` type `{ id, menu, label, icon, defaultKey?, undoable, native, run(ctx) }` + `defineCommand()` registry mirroring `defineEventType()`'s anti-collision pattern (duplicate id OR duplicate default hotkey both throw at registration). Resolution helpers `commandById`, `commandsByMenu`, `resolveHotkey` all point at one identical `CommandDef` (menu = source of truth). Plus `runCommand`, `hotkeyFor`, `registeredCommands`, and light rebinding (`rebindHotkey`/`exportHotkeys`/`loadHotkeys`).
- `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/runtime/commands/index.ts` — re-exports the surface.
- `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/runtime/commands/commands.test.ts` — 13-test micro-harness.

**Tests: 13 passed, 0 failed** via the prescribed esbuild + v8cli flow.

**Integration line other systems need:** a command's `run(ctx)` EMITs — it imports `dispatch` + an event factory from `runtime/editorbus` and dispatches; `ctx.targets` (a `TargetRef[]`) flows straight into the emitted event's `targets` so dirty-tracking stays O(1). Consumers register commands at module load with `defineCommand({...})`; the cart menu bar renders from `commandsByMenu(menu)` and the keydown loop calls `resolveHotkey(chordFromEvent(ev))?.run({ targets })`.

**Contract notes / gaps hit:**
- `CommandContext` shape (`{ targets?, args? }`) is my own design — the contract doc didn't specify what `run`'s ctx carries. Kept it narrow: commands EMIT, so ctx gives the targets/args to shape the event, never a state handle.
- `Menu` is typed as open `string` (the doc treats `TargetRef.kind` as open vocabulary; menus follow suit). The workspace-mock's fixed `MENUS` array can layer a stricter union on top cart-side if desired.
- Persistence is deliberately light (in-process override map + export/load round-trip) per the "do NOT over-engineer rebinding" constraint; wiring it to localstore is a cart-layer concern, matching how the donor pushed persistence to the React layer.</result>
